page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Four numbered theses (LXXXIX, XC, XCI, XCII), each as one paragraph with an italic citation at its end. No margin notes, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Cœlestium verborum simplicitate pro voluntatis suæ sensu, non pro veritatis ipsius absolutione susceperunt aliter interpretanda, quàm dictorum virtus postularet. De intelligentia enim hæresis, non de Scriptura est, & sensus non sermo sit crimen. lib. 2.

Videntur sibi de singulis quæ asserunt præ-stare rationem, quia singulis assertionibus suis quædam ex divinis voluminibus testimonia subdiderunt, quæ corrupto intelligentiæ sensu solis tantum[?] ignorantibus blandiantur, speciem veritatis secundum prauitatem interpretantium præstitura. lib. 4.

Grauis & periculosus est error in plurimis, & multorum lapsus: etiamsi se intelligat, tamen exurgendi pudore autoritatem sibi præsumit, ex numero habens hoc impudentiæ, ut quod errat, prudentiā velit existimari: & quod cum multis errat, intelligentiam esse asserat veritatis, dum minus erroris esse existimatur in multis. lib. 6.

Incredibilibus se corrupti ingenii artibus hæretica subtilitas circumegit: primùm ut fingeret religionem, deinde ut omnium sim-plicium aurium securitate verbis falleret, tum præterea ut se prudentiæ sæculi coaptaret, postremò ut veritatis intelligentiam per speciem[?]

page.notes: The page number reads "9ƒ", taken as 91; the long s is rendered as s throughout. Last line is cut at the lower edge of the scan, so "speciem" is uncertain. "tantum" is uncertain (may read "tantium"). The hyphenated "præ-stare" and "sim-plicium" are line-end breaks with printed hyphens. Printing errors are left as printed.
